# Agri Experience

> Agri Experience is an agricultural consulting firm transforming seed systems and agricultural value chains across 21 African countries. The organization works with development partners, governments, regulators, breeding institutions, and the private sector to strengthen food security and farmer livelihoods.

Agri Experience operates across East, West, Central, and Southern Africa. Core services include seed systems development, digital agricultural tools, field project implementation, and capacity building. The website is available in English and French.

## Pages

- [Home](https://agri-experience.com/): Overview of services, interactive map of 21 operating countries, partner organizations, and impact statistics
- [About Us](https://agri-experience.com/about): Mission, vision, values, organizational timeline, and company background
- [Our Work](https://agri-experience.com/our-work): Core consulting services including seed systems, digital tools, and field project methodology
- [Our Results](https://agri-experience.com/our-results): Key performance metrics, outcomes by category, and case studies
- [Our Impact](https://agri-experience.com/our-impact): Impact areas, SDG alignment, impact stories, and metrics dashboard
- [Our Team](https://agri-experience.com/our-team): Leadership and staff profiles
- [Resources](https://agri-experience.com/resources): Downloadable tools, guides, and case study documents
- [Insights](https://agri-experience.com/insights): Blog articles, research publications, and thought leadership
- [Contact](https://agri-experience.com/contact): Contact form, regional office locations, and inquiry information
- [Newsletter](https://agri-experience.com/newsletter): Newsletter signup with topic interests and frequency options

## Key Focus Areas

- [Seed Systems Development](https://agri-experience.com/our-work): Strengthening national and regional seed value chains across Africa
- [Project Implementation](https://agri-experience.com/our-work/project-implementation): On-the-ground project delivery and management
- [Impact Measurement](https://agri-experience.com/our-impact): Tracking and reporting outcomes aligned with Sustainable Development Goals
